## reference · AI SEO for SaaS
* AI SEO is increasing in importance in the B2B SaaS purchase process.
* Integrating AI SEO efforts with traditional SEO, content, Reddit marketing, authority building, and PR is crucial.
* Domain Rating (DR) is a strong AI SEO lever, with DR 81-100 sites having 5.5x more ChatGPT brand mentions than DR 1-60 sites.
* "Best of" listicles are the top-performing content type in LLMs.
* A company's own domain can be cited more often than Reddit, Wikipedia, YouTube, and Forbes for non-branded prompts.
* Measuring AI SEO success involves using multiple KPIs, different from traditional SEO success metrics.
* 68% of B2B SaaS CMOs start their search for new software with an AI tool.
* 69% of B2B buyers select a different vendor than originally planned based on AI answer engine recommendations.
* Original research on a site increases brand visibility by 28.7% in SaaS and 10.5% in fintech.
* Embedding FAQs in content pages drives 14.4% and 12.5% higher visibility.
* Having a Wikipedia page increases brand visibility by 19.1%-68.5%.
* A G2 rating of 4.51+ vs. 3.0 or lower increases brand visibility by 95.3%-671%.
* Schema markup has no direct correlation with AI SEO visibility.
* Average prompt length has dropped by 50% year over year, with buyers treating AI search like Google with shorter queries.
* Google traditional search still powers 80.76% of all online searches.
Sources: https://stratabeat.com/ai-seo-for-saas/
